notice: Human-approved rules. They reference catalog entries (catalog.json, parsed from the official Upgrading Guide) by entry_id; title, version, anchor and URL come from the catalog. Detection is expressed only as detector + params from backend/app/detection/detectors.py. Approved rules always take precedence over LLM candidates for the same entry.

rules.source_quote: Since this release, the hostname does not accept such type of wildcard and those patterns will be managed as if the wildcard is after the hostname https://example.com/*.
rules.remediation: Replace every valid redirect URI with a wildcard right after the host (e.g. https://example.com*) with an explicit host followed by a path (e.g. https://example.com/*), register other hosts explicitly, and prefer exact redirect URIs.

rules.source_quote: This functionality was deprecated in Keycloak 18 and has been removed in this version in favor of following the OpenID Connect specification.
rules.remediation: Implement OpenID Connect RP-Initiated Logout: send post_logout_redirect_uri together with id_token_hint (or client_id) and register the URI in 'Valid post logout redirect URIs'.

rules.source_quote: As this has led to a hard-to-configure URL filtering, for example, in reverse proxies, the normalization is now disabled, and Keycloak responds with an HTTP 400 response code.
rules.remediation: Normalize request URLs in client libraries and reverse proxies (collapse '//' and resolve dot segments). The option http-accept-non-normalized-paths=true restores the old behaviour only temporarily: it is deprecated.

rules.source_quote: In this release, the role and client mappers now map to a single value from the effective roles of a user when they are marked as single-valued (Multivalued disabled).
rules.remediation: If consumers expect all roles, enable 'Multivalued' on the role mapper and read the claim as a JSON array; otherwise update consumers that parsed the former stringified JSON array, which now receive a single role value.

controls.title: Calls on monitored endpoints not attributable to a client
controls.remediation: Enable MDC (log-mdc-enabled with the clientId key) and make clients send client_id explicitly, so that runtime evidence can be attributed to a Keycloak client.
